classification_rule.DT-0: the carry-only process is reducible to current carry or the latest overwrite and has no matched-present future-divergence witness
classification_rule.DT-1: additional distinctions are completely reproduced by a registered output buffer, local history, generic memory, or other non-relational control
classification_rule.DT-2: at least one witness passes every registered H2 condition, including matched-null separation and nontrivial relational recovery

primary_endpoints: exact behavioral equivalence classes in F0 and F1
full-present-matched histories separated by a common future suffix
relational recovery beyond scalar or buffered state return
title: Reversible Closure versus Dissipative Relational Transfer
